text.p: Starbucks Corp on Friday raised coffee prices by five cents, according to retailers.
The retailers said they received a memo from the company informing them of the price hike, effective immediately. Food prices remain unchanged.

The move follows a sharp rise in coffee prices recently, fueled in part by heavy rains in South America and labor unrest in Colombia. In the last three months coffee futures prices have doubled, putting pressure on retailers to raise prices.
A spokesman for Starbucks was not immediately available to comment on the price hikes.

Last week, Starbucks Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Howard Schultz said company executives have been watching coffee prices carefully and the company planned to make an announcement on its strategy within the next several days.
He said the company has waited because it did not want to "rush to judgement" and raise prices without a good understanding of the forces driving the recent price volatility.
